result:
**Root cause:** `updateTerminal` (`variants/bug07/movegen.inc:1180`) asked `moverInCheck` — which ignores its argument and reports on the side that *just moved*, never in check after a legal move — instead of `inCheckSide(sideToMove)`, so every position with no legal moves fell through to the stalemate branch.

**Fix:** one instruction, `call moverInCheck` → `call inCheckSide`, at the call site only; `moverInCheck` itself is unchanged because its four other callers (genLegal, engine.inc ×2, perft.inc) run right after `makeMove` and need its current semantics. Exactly one code byte differs in the tape; nothing moved.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug07/movegen.inc` — the 1-line fix
- `variants/bug07/terminal_test.py` — new, 6-case regression test
- `variants/bug07/Makefile` — new `terminal` target, run as the last step of `test`
- `variants/bug07/BUILD.md` — documents both
- `variants/bug07/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt by `make` (reproduce byte-for-byte)
- `STATE.md`, `FIX_NOTES.md` — workspace root

**Gates**
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS. All three mate repros now end `Checkmate! White wins` / `Checkmate! Black wins` with gameState 2/1; both controls (real stalemate, check-with-replies) unchanged.
- `make test` — PASS. Golden board, engine replies to 1.e4, perft self-test, tape save/load round-trip, 128K banked TT, plus the new terminal cases.
- New test — PASS. 6 ok / 0 failed on the fixed tape; verified it **fails on the pre-fix tape** (2 ok / 4 failed), which is what makes it a regression test. Runs standalone as `make terminal`.
- Characterisation suite — PASS, 57 ok / 0 failed / exit 0. It was 54/3 before the fix, the three red cases being exactly `tm_fools_mate`, `tm_scholars_mate`, `se_mate_in_one`. `expected.json` was not re-recorded.
- Code review — PASS. One round, verdict "no defect in the fix"; gate closed at round 1 of a cap of 3. The reviewer independently rebuilt a pre-fix tape and reproduced both the 54/3 characterisation split and the 2/4 test split, and found a path (`aiMove` returning without a move) where the new call is correct and the old one was not.

**Knowingly left open** (all recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md` §6, none blocking)
- Terminal classification is tested on the 48K machine only; no `hc128` case. The changed instruction is machine-independent shared movegen code.
- Two pre-existing defects the reviewer surfaced and proved pre-existing on a pre-fix rebuild: `chess.asm:281-283` logs a bogus ply and pushes a garbage undo slot when `aiMove` returns without a move (unreachable in practice); and a position already terminal when loaded with `L` or built in the editor is not classified until a move is attempted.
- The variant `Makefile`'s `SRC` list omits `perft.inc`, `zobrist.inc`, `tt.inc`, so edits to those do not trigger a rebuild.

I also closed three of the reviewer's non-blocking findings since they were cheap: every test case now asserts the game's own move log (the `check_not_terminal` row could otherwise have passed vacuously), the test no longer leaks a temp directory per run, and a wrong target name in `STATE.md` was corrected. The reviewed fix itself is unchanged since the verdict; all gates were re-run after those test-only edits.
